title: Services
text: The Service Provider shall provide software development and maintenance services to the Client as described in the applicable project statement.

title: Service Standards
text: The Service Provider shall perform the services in a professional and reasonable manner and shall comply with the agreed project requirements. ARTICLE 2 - PAYMENT

title: Fees
text: The Client shall pay the Service Provider a fixed fee of $10,000 for the services described in this Agreement.

title: Payment Terms
text: Invoices shall be payable within 30 days of receipt. No additional charges shall apply unless approved in writing by both parties. ARTICLE 3 - CONFIDENTIALITY

title: Confidential Information
text: Each party shall protect confidential information received from the other party and shall use such information only for purposes of performing this Agreement. ARTICLE 4 - TERM AND TERMINATION

title: Term
text: This Agreement shall commence on January 1, 2027 and shall remain in effect for one year.

title: Termination
text: Either party may terminate this Agreement by providing 30 days written notice to the other party. ARTICLE 5 - LIABILITY

title: Limitation of Liability
text: Except for obligations that cannot legally be limited, each party's aggregate liability shall not exceed the total fees paid under this Agreement. ARTICLE 6 - GOVERNING LAW

title: Governing Law
text: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of New York. ARTICLE 7 - GENERAL

title: Assignment
text: Neither party may assign this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other party.

title: Entire Agreement
text: This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties concerning the subject matter described herein.
